liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Dark Star explores the whole Wells Fargo Center space; Dark Star ran 28 minutes, believed to be the band's longest single-song jam so far [12][13]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Ramble On Rose turned into an old-school sing-along with the crowd [3]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): West L.A. Fadeaway was a bright spot where the band soared, despite some meandering elsewhere [5]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Dark Star flows into Truckin' with teases beginning midway through the jam [13]
- **Deal** (1 review): Deal was singled out by an attendee as especially intense [10]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Row Jimmy, Eyes of the World and Dear Prudence were named highlights [12]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Black Muddy River was beautiful, and Deal was explosive [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Minglewood Blues**: rare: 11 archived performances [14]
- **Smokestack Lightning**: rare: 14 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2017-11-16.litzenberger.schoepsMK41v.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 195 min; rated 4.5/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds very warm; In the venue, the sound was bass heavy and at times incoherent where the reviewer sat [5][11]
- **DeadCo2017-11-16.litzenberger.schoepsMK41v.flac24192**: source not stated; 18 songs; 196 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- A talkative person near the taper's right channel can be heard chatting throughout the show [6]
- The recording's mix suits the band better than the mix on the live video feeds [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2017-11-16.litzenberger.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>KCY 250/05i>VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-6 [1]. Also: Schoeps MK41V mics into a Sound Devices MixPre-6, recorded at 24/192 from the back of the GA pit; downconverted to 16-bit/44.1 kHz FLAC by Keith Litzenberger [1]
- **DeadCo2017-11-16.litzenberger.schoepsMK41v.flac24192**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41V's>Schoeps KCY 25/05i>Schoeps VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-6 [2]. Also: Keith Litzenberger recorded with Schoeps MK41V mics into a MixPre-6 at 24-bit/192 kHz, from the back of the GA pit; this fileset stays at full resolution [2]
